```python
import flet as ft

def main(page: ft.Page):
    con1 = ft.Column(
        controls=[
            ft.Container(
                width=150,
                height=150,
                margin=20,
                bgcolor=ft.colors.GREEN,
                border_radius=20,
            ),
            ft.Text("width=150\nheight=150\nmargin=20\nbgcolor=ft.colors.GREEN\nborder_radius=20")
        ],
        horizontal_alignment=ft.CrossAxisAlignment.CENTER
    )

    con2 = ft.Column(
        controls=[
            ft.Container(
                padding=50,
                margin=20,
                content=ft.Text("Googleが開きます"),
                bgcolor="BLUE",
                url = "https://www.google.com/",
            ),
            ft.Text('padding=50\nmargin=20\ncontent=ft.Text("Googleが開きます")\nbgcolor="BLUE"\nurl = "https://www.google.com/"')
        ],
        horizontal_alignment=ft.CrossAxisAlignment.CENTER
    )

    con3 = ft.Column(
        controls=[
            ft.Container(
                padding=20,
                margin=20,
                content=ft.Column(
                    controls=[
                        ft.Icon(ft.icons.PETS),
                        ft.Text("複数コントロールも設置可能！"),
                        ft.Icon(ft.icons.ROCKET),
                    ],
                    horizontal_alignment=ft.CrossAxisAlignment.CENTER
                ),
                bgcolor=ft.colors.RED,
            ),
            ft.Text("padding=20\nmargin=20\ncontent=中略・以下コードを参照\nbgcolor=ft.colors.RED")
        ],
        horizontal_alignment=ft.CrossAxisAlignment.CENTER
    )

    row = ft.Row(
        controls=[
            con1,
            con2,
            con3
        ]
    )

    page.add(row)

ft.app(target=main)
```
